stemMd: A vertical prism has an L-shaped plan formed by a 6 by 4 rectangle with a 2 by 2 corner removed. Its height is 3. Which measurement cannot be recovered from the front silhouette alone if the missing corner lies entirely behind the front face?

options.label: A
options.textMd: The height of the visible front rectangle

options.label: B
options.textMd: Whether the front silhouette is rectangular

options.label: C
options.textMd: The total width of the front face

options.label: E
options.textMd: The depth of the removed corner

explanationMd: A recess hidden entirely behind the front face does not alter the external front silhouette. Its depth is lost in that projection. Plan information or hidden lines are needed to identify the removed region.

distractorRationale.d: The silhouette retains the vertical span.
distractorRationale.c: The front face spans the full width.
distractorRationale.a: This is directly shown by its vertical extent.
distractorRationale.b: The problem explicitly establishes the unobstructed front face.
